summary.launched: Started {{count}} run(s). Call specrails_wait(until, refs) to follow them.
summary.launched_partial: Started {{count}} run(s); {{failed}} launch(es) were refused, see data.refused.
summary.launch_all_none: No rail could start: see data.results for each rail's reason.
summary.accepted: {{label}} accepted. Call specrails_wait(until, refs) to follow it.
summary.edit_spec: Edit the spec with specrails_specs(update), then continue the run.
summary.recovery: {{label}} done on the run's original worktree.
preview.sequential: They run one after another in a single run; for one run per spec, each on its own rail, add options.parallel: true.
preview.launch_all: Launches {{count}} rail(s) with their own settings.
preview.time: Runs like this usually take {{low}}–{{high}} min.
preview.queue: The machine is busy: {{running}} running, new runs wait for a free slot.
preview.cancel: Cancels {{title}}; its unfinished work stops for good.
preview.check: Runs the {{kind}} check of {{title}} in its worktree: it executes the project's own commands.
preview.fork: Starts a new attempt of {{title}} from step {{step}}.
error.not_held: {{label}}: the run is not waiting for that (it is {{status}}).
error.no_option: Option "{{option}}" is not one the question offered: {{options}}.
error.reject_reason: reject needs the reason in answer.
error.no_rail: The run is not on a rail, so it cannot start over; launch its specs again.
error.change_model: Changing the model is a new launch: specrails_runs(launch, target:{specIds}, model).
error.bad_target: target needs one of specIds, rail, loopId, command or template.
error.rail_empty: Rail {{rail}} has no specs to launch. Put specs on it with specrails_rails(configure), or launch them directly with target.specIds.
error.fork_step: fork needs options.fromStep (a step id from view detail, fields graph).
error.cannot_continue: This run can no longer continue from its failed step: its saved state is gone. Launch the spec again (a new run).
why.launch_again: Launch the spec again as a new run.
choice.stop: Stops the run; finished steps stay.
choice.settle: Turns the finished run into a delivery.
choice.dismiss: Hides it from what waits; nothing else changes.
